title: EffectsHud
description: A cleaner status-effect HUD with sortable timers, amplifier levels, and a warning before key effects expire.
body:
# BuffTimer
Never let an important potion run out unnoticed. BuffTimer replaces the plain effect icons with a clear, sortable list of timers.

## Features
- Status-effect rows with name, level, and remaining time
- Sort by time, name, or beneficial-first
- Expiry warning for effects you care about
- Configurable position and scale

## How to use
Install and your active effects appear as a tidy timer list.

Client-side. Requires Fabric API and Yet Another Config Lib (YACL).
